newsitem.title: USA: Levitz Furniture Sept same-store sales dip.
newsitem.headline: Levitz Furniture Sept same-store sales dip.

text.p: Levitz Furniture Inc said Thursday that sales for the month of September amounted to $80.6 million compared to $84.4 million last year, a decrease of 4.5 percent. For stores open more than one year, the sales decrease was 4.5 percent.

For the first six months of the fiscal year, sales amounted to $465.3 million vs. $493.1 million last year, a decrease of 5.6 percent. For stores open more than one year, the decrease amounted to 5.7 percent.
The company added that September had one less Saturday than the year ago month.
